title: Kernel-routed TypeScript with a parse error defers to the wasm arm
description: A routed language whose parse tree contains errors must surface the kernel's `defer:` signal, leave a defer memo, and fall back to the wasm extractor. The negative assertion forbids silently returning an empty ExtractionResult without an error.

errors.message_contains: Failed to get parser for language

must_not: return a non-null kernel ExtractionResult for this source
return an empty ExtractionResult with no error and no defer signal
throw a kernel error whose message does not contain 'defer:'

provenance.derivation: Executed tryKernelExtract and takeDeferredPreParse against the darwin-arm64 kernel prebuild on 2026-10-30; wasm-without-preload error observed via extractFromSource.
